rows.en: ...Gandal, the conquest of Earth seems to be far behind schedule.
I-I beg your forgiveness, King Vega.
The forces resisting us, led by Grendizer, are stronger than we expected, and those Gulfer have appeared as well...
rows.notes: Gandal trails off while explaining unexpectedly strong resistance and Gulfer arrival.

rows.en: I have no interest in your excuses. We have very little time left!
C-could the Vegatron deposits be... even worse than we expected!?
rows.notes: Interrupted reference to worsening Vegatron deposits; no invented depletion rate.

rows.en: Yes. That is why we must make Earth our new base, to prepare for battle with the Gulfer and the others.
Yes!
rows.notes: Bare affirmative; no added royal title.

rows.en: Listen well, Gandal... I will send Gilgilgan to you. Use it to dispose of those who stand in our way.
As you command.
Then I look forward to your report on the results.
...King Vega is making quite a bold move, deploying that thing.
Barendos, do you know of Gilgilgan?
Yes. It's a space monster that was captured during an interstellar war some time ago.
rows.notes: Capturing force is unspecified; passive retained to avoid inventing captors.

rows.en: A monster hated throughout the stars, like Sky Beast Grangen and the others... They say its power rivals even Lagowe's.
rows.notes: Full Sky Beast Grangen designation and Lagowe power comparison retained.

rows.en: Though I hear the Gulfer have captured Lagowe as well.
Regardless, these orders come directly from King Vega. We cannot afford to fail.
Commander Gandal, please order me, Blacky, to sortie!
rows.notes: Blacky asks Gandal to order Blacky into action; request direction and self-reference retained.

rows.en: You claim you can control Gilgilgan?
Y-yes, sir! To make up for all my failures so far...!
rows.notes: Stuttered affirmative followed by a deliberately unfinished purpose clause.

rows.en: ...Very well. Then sortie.
Understood, sir.
...We have two possible routes to Chongqing Base.
The first takes us over the Yellow Sea to the Yellow River, then onward with the Qinling Mountains as a barrier...
rows.notes: Trailing route-list ellipsis retained.

rows.en: The second follows the Yangtze from Shanghai.
So we have a northern route and a southern route.
Yes. Giganos forces have landed in northern China, so we're very likely to come under attack on the Yellow River route.
But on the Yangtze route, Tekkoryu may target us. Their headquarters are said to be in southern China.
So either way, the risk is high... Captain, what will you do?
The Giganos forces want the D-Weapons. Let's take the Yangtze River route to avoid them as much as possible.
rows.notes: Southern route choice; original23-29 supplies northern/southern alternatives.

rows.en: Understood.
rows.notes: Misato acknowledges Vega's coverage.

rows.en: ...You want to change our route to Chongqing?
rows.notes: Alternate northern-route branch prompts a route change.

rows.en: Yes. We received a report from the front in northern China that the Giganos forces have begun to move.
It seems they've learned of the battle at Shaolin Temple.
Yes...
Then let's switch to the Yangtze River route to avoid contact with the Giganos forces.
Captain Bright, we're receiving an emergency transmission from the Federation's Hangzhou Base!
rows.notes: Central glossary now supplies Hangzhou Base; real city spelling and fictional base provenance remain distinct.
uncertain: Hangzhou Base is source-compositional; no independently established licensed English base label. UNESCO confirms city spelling only.

rows.en: An emergency transmission...? What does it say!?
They report that the Shanghai area is under attack by the Vegan Empire forces!
What...!?
Why are the Vegan Empire forces attacking Shanghai...!?
Have they given up attacking Japan for now, where the defenses are relatively strong...? Or are they trying to lure us out...?
rows.notes: Two unresolved hypotheses: pause attacks on well-defended Japan or lure this group out. Defenders not narrowed to this group.

rows.en: It's probably the latter.
Judging by what they've done so far, their main objective is to crush forces like ours that can resist them.
rows.notes: Enemy primary aim is crushing opposing forces like this group.

rows.en: And how is the battle going...!?
The enemy has deployed an unidentified giant creature, and our allies are at a disadvantage.
A giant creature? It isn't a Saucer Beast?
Y-yes...
rows.notes: Affirms creature is not a Saucer Beast, answering39.

rows.en: Could it be a space monster like Grangen...!?
If it is, regular troops might have a bit of a tough time with it.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: Captain Bright, let's head for Shanghai right away!
Wait. Our top priority is to transport the D-Weapons to Chongqing. We shouldn't waste time now.
rows.notes: Douglas prioritizes D-Weapons delivery over Shanghai diversion.

rows.en: A waste of time...!?
rows.notes: Outraged echo of Douglas calling rescue a waste of time; intentional echo fragment.

rows.en: Listen. Our unit isn't the only one fighting this war.
If each unit gets its mission priorities wrong, it will affect the course of the entire war.
Then please let us go on our own, at least!
rows.notes: Daisuke asks permission for his group to go alone.

rows.en: Captain!
rows.notes: Address-only appeal to Captain Bright.

rows.en: ...All hands, Level 1 battle stations. Set this ship's course for Shanghai.
Roger!
rows.notes: Torres acknowledges.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat condition; zero manual breaks.

rows.en: We've already disposed of the Earthling small fry!
Now, Gilgilgan! Destroy the city and devour all the iron you desire!
Hahaha! Excellent, Gilgilgan!
Blacky, we've detected machines approaching our position!
rows.notes: Source honorific dropped under binding convention.

rows.en: How many?
rows.notes: Count question restored from approaching-machine report.

rows.en: Two!
Then they must be Grendizer and Mazinger Z.
Heh heh heh. They walked right into my trap.
No, sir! It isn't those two machines!
What...?
You're not getting away with any more of this, Vegan Empire!
Great Mazinger!? Barendos said that thing was supposed to be in a robot museum...!!
Hmph. If I leave it on display there, sneak thieves like you come after it. So I've brought it back into active service!
rows.notes: Great Mazinger returned to active service because display exposes it to thieves.

rows.en: You fool... If you'd stayed out of this, you wouldn't have to die here.
I'll throw those words right back at you.
rows.notes: Returns Blacky death threat; no added action.

rows.en: No, Tetsuya! Our job is to buy time for the Federation troops to withdraw!
rows.notes: Jun reminds Tetsuya they must buy withdrawal time.

rows.en: I don't give a damn about those troops running away! If we don't defeat the enemy, they'll just keep wrecking the city!
rows.notes: Retreating troops, without inventing coward epithet; enemy defeat prevents continued city damage.

rows.en: This isn't quite what we planned, but Great Mazinger's Super Alloy New Z and Photon Power energy will make fine food for Gilgilgan, too.
rows.notes: Great Mazinger source-short Great expanded for clear referent; canonical material/energy names retained.

rows.en: We'll leave the rest to it and fall back!
rows.notes: Blacky and troops withdraw, leaving Gilgilgan to fight.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
They ran away...!?
rows.notes: Jun reacts to Blacky and troops retreating.

rows.en: Let them go! Right now, taking down that lizard comes first!
No matter. Blacky will be the one held responsible for this failure...!
rows.notes: Separate event5 remark; no invented response to Tetsuya.

rows.en: You lousy lizard! You're going to help me warm up!!
rows.notes: Event8 combat quote; lizard insult retained. Source contempt conveyed with lousy; no added explicit swear.

rows.en: Is this the space monster Dr. Saotome was talking about...!?
rows.notes: Event8 identity question to monster, not a claim it is already identified.

rows.en: B-Boss! That thing's heading this way!!
rows.notes: Mucha warns Boss; source stutter retained.

rows.en: This is my chance to shine! I'll land at least one good hit on it!
You space monster!
rows.notes: Addressed angry epithet, intentionally fragmentary; following original234 supplies Earth-defense vow. Contemptuous addressed epithet; no added explicit swear.

rows.en: Even if you reach your final form, my friends and I won't let you do as you please with Earth!
So you're the Great Mazinger I've heard so much about!
Damn you, Vegan Empire! How dare you try to use Great for your evil schemes!
rows.notes: Coordinator review: removed the added noun epithet while preserving the hostile address and challenge.

rows.en: I'll show you what Great and I can really do! You'll feel it firsthand!
Interesting! I came to Earth to defeat men like you!
And I returned to the battlefield to defeat the likes of you!
rows.notes: Coordinator review: removed the added noun epithet while preserving the hostile address and challenge.

rows.en: Duke Fleed, today I'll take your head!
Even if I fall, other warriors will follow me and defend Earth's peace!
And I will never lose to you devils!
Here I come, space monster! I'll make you regret coming to Earth!
My mistake is what let you run rampant...
And now I'm going to make up for that!!
rows.notes: Tetsuya explicitly accepts responsibility for the mistake in 90 rather than suggesting a revenge score.

rows.en: Hurry, everyone! We have to finish it off within this one minute!
We can defeat any enemy if we bring all our strength together!
Don't tell me this thing... is going to turn into a machine next...
Kaine! Quit thinking about stupid stuff and attack already!
We can do this...! We have to trust in our own strength and defeat this thing!
rows.notes: Self-encouragement restored as resolve/necessity rather than a prediction.

rows.en: We have to stop it...! If we don't, the whole city of Shanghai will be destroyed!!
rows.notes: Restored the context-settled stop action in the first clause; Japanese grammatical omission is not treated as an intentional unfinished verb.

rows.en: Here I come, monster! I'll hit you harder than you can regenerate!!
Guh! Th-this thing... Great!?
rows.notes: Source interruption retained; following sensor report settles the attack as Great being seized for energy absorption, without spelling out the unfinished verb. Restored deliberate source interruption after the object Great; the monster is the settled actor, but the unfinished verb is not invented.

rows.en: T-Tetsuya!!
Get away! Hurry!!
D-damn it!!
Huh!? W-what's this reading!?
rows.notes: Sensor reading, not a physical reaction; Megumi answers Misato in original 258. Rendered the initial exclamation as spoken shock rather than a standalone punctuation mark.

rows.en: What's going on?!
rows.notes: Misato asks about the disturbance.

rows.en: It looks like Gilgilgan is absorbing Great Mazinger's energy!
What did you say?!
rows.notes: Misato demands clarification, also reused at the energy report.

rows.en: I-it went and transformed!?
There's no doubt...! That power...!!
rows.notes: Source trails off after recognizing the power; no invented conclusion.

rows.en: Tch, that bastard...!!
Captain Bright, it's dangerous to stay here! Please order a retreat!
What do you mean!?
Gilgilgan is a space monster that grows by consuming metal and energy!
If we fight it carelessly, we'll only give it more power!
What...!?
We should pull back for now and work out a countermeasure!
Understood! We'll recover Great Mazinger, then leave this airspace!
...Captain Katsuragi, what is Gilgilgan doing?
rows.notes: Captain Katsuragi is sourced by Misato's main glossary character profile: current [jp] = Captain; later Major is not applied.

rows.en: It's still in Shanghai's urban area.
Just as you said earlier... it seems to be eating buildings and absorbing energy, including electricity.
I see...
Daisuke, do you know something about that monster?
This is the first time I've actually seen it... but I heard rumors about it back on Planet Fleed.
Rumors...?
rows.notes: Echo question fragment retained.

rows.en: ...Some say it's a biological weapon created by an ancient civilization, but the details are unknown...
rows.notes: Uncertainty about the weapon origin belongs to the source, not translator doubt.

rows.en: Apparently, it has destroyed several planets.
A biological weapon... So that's why humans can control it.
Hey, what happens if it keeps growing like this?
It will transform further... and keep eating metal and absorbing energy until it reaches its limit.
...It's just like the Devil Gundam.
At least it doesn't make things like the Death Army... but we can't leave it alone.
Yeah. We've gotta take it down right here.
...It's just like the Devil Gundam.
It's a small mercy that it doesn't create subordinate units like the Death Army, but...
rows.notes: Trailing but retained; next row supplies the objection. Subordinate units preserves terminal/subordinate-machine detail. Preserved terminal/subordinate-machine detail without implying a remote-control mechanism the source does not state.

rows.en: We can't leave it alone.
...So, Misato. How do we beat it?
Well, we'll have to use the same principle as bursting a rubber balloon.
Huh?
rows.notes: Full spoken meaning retained; speaker/listener settled from original neighbors.

rows.en: If you keep pumping air into a rubber balloon, it'll eventually exceed its limit and burst, right?
In other words, we blast it with more energy than it can hold, all in a very short time.
So several of us concentrate our attacks on it?
Exactly. Luckily, we have plenty of machines that run on some pretty outrageous energy sources...
It's the old idea of everyone joining forces.
Oh, so we're just using the same old strategy after all.
Then this'll be a piece of cake!
I wouldn't say that. Doing it quickly is the hard part.
Yeah. If we take too long, Gilgilgan will use our machines' energy
rows.notes: Sentence cut at original boundary; row 144 completes the consequence.

rows.en: and get even stronger.
rows.notes: Continuation of row 143, preserving the cross-row sentence.

rows.en: Then how much time do we have to defeat it?
Based on its energy conversion rate earlier, I'd say we have about a minute...
rows.notes: Aqua derives the one-minute estimate from the earlier conversion rate, not an unrelated tactical guess.

rows.en: That's right.
We have to defeat that monster in just one minute...?
rows.notes: Source trails off in disbelief; settled defeat action restored.

rows.en: Yes. To do that, we'll need to buy ourselves time to get our attack ready.
Then someone will have to act as a decoy?
Well, that's what it comes down to.
...Let me take that role. I've got a score to settle with Gilgilgan.
rows.notes: Tetsuya volunteers himself as the decoy and wants payback against Gilgilgan. Made the hostile payback sense explicit, avoiding the possible favor/debt reading of owe one.
Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: ...I'm against it. I don't want you butting in during this battle.
rows.notes: Ryoma addresses Tetsuya; objection concerns his grandstanding in this battle.

rows.en: What...?
Ryo...!
rows.notes: Source nickname is Ryo, distinct from prefilled Ryoma speaker.

rows.en: ...Would you mind telling me why?
rows.notes: Tetsuya requests Ryoma explain his objection.

rows.en: Yes, I'll be blunt. Your arrogance is what brought this on.
Hmph... You only came strolling in after it happened. Who are you to talk?
rows.notes: Tetsuya challenges Ryoma for arriving only after the incident.

rows.en: But if you'd made sure to finish Gilgilgan off back then... none of this would have happened.
What did you say...!?
rows.notes: Tetsuya angrily challenges Ryoma's accusation; explicit spoken reaction.

rows.en: I've been concerned about your grandstanding for a while now, Tetsuya.
rows.notes: Ryoma addresses Tetsuya directly; stand play means grandstanding, not a solo performance.

rows.en: And when you got hurt in the final battle with Mycenae...
rows.notes: Ryoma begins linking the Mycenae injury to grandstanding; interrupted clause retained.

rows.en: H-hey! Cut it out, Ryo!
rows.notes: Benkei asks Ryoma to stop; Ryo nickname kept distinct from speaker Ryoma.

rows.en: He's right. This is no time for you two to fight among yourselves.
rows.notes: Daisuke backs Benkei and addresses both men; both participants named as you two.
Tetsuya's silent shocked reaction; punctuation-only omission retained.

rows.en: Tetsuya... Unless you change your attitude, I have no intention of fighting alongside you.
rows.notes: Ryoma makes cooperation conditional on Tetsuya changing his attitude; negative commitment retained.

rows.en: I see... Fine, then.
rows.notes: Tetsuya accepts the refusal tersely and leaves; implied I restored.

rows.en: Ah...! Wait, Tetsuya!
rows.notes: Jun calls after Tetsuya; stutter/reaction and wait direction preserved.

rows.en: Good grief. I thought something like this would happen sooner or later, but...
rows.notes: Misato privately anticipates this conflict; thought kind and unfinished reservation retained.

rows.en: Ryo, you went too far there.
rows.notes: Daisuke rebukes Ryoma for excessive words; Ryo address retained.

rows.en: ...I'll go help with Getter maintenance. Please tell me the details of the plan later.
rows.notes: Ryoma leaves to help maintain Getter and asks to be briefed later; request belongs to Ryoma.

rows.en: H-hey, Ryo!
rows.notes: Boss calls after Ryoma; Ryo nickname and stutter retained.

rows.en: Shouldn't we do something about this?
rows.notes: Tapp asks the group whether they should intervene; we restored.

rows.en: Just leave them alone. They're the ones who'll get hurt anyway.
rows.notes: Asuka dismisses intervention; they refers to the two quarreling men.

rows.en: We can't just do that!
rows.notes: Kaine rejects Asuka's laissez-faire response; we restored.

rows.en: Then why don't you go after them and talk some sense into them?
rows.notes: Asuka tells Kaine he could follow and persuade the men; direction is Kaine acting.

rows.en: ...There's no need for that, and there's nothing to worry about.
rows.notes: Koji reassures the group; no invented explanation for his confidence.

rows.en: What's that supposed to mean?
rows.notes: Asuka asks Koji to explain the reassurance; full question restored.

rows.en: Heh, you'll find out soon enough... Very soon.
rows.notes: Koji promises an imminent explanation; repeated soon retained.
Asuka's puzzled question mark; no added words or subject.

rows.en: ...Let's get back to the matter at hand. As for buying time... we'll use Gilgilgan's favorite food.
rows.notes: Misato resumes planning; favorite food is bait for buying time.

rows.en: What's that?
rows.notes: Sai Saici asks which favorite food; ordinary conversational register.

rows.en: What is it?
rows.notes: Mari echoes the food question; natural slightly less slangy phrasing.

rows.en: I had Light check with his D-3 a little while ago...
rows.notes: Haruka explains she asked Light to investigate via D-3; source trails into the finding.

rows.en: It seems Gilgilgan likes to eat iron.
rows.notes: Haruka identifies Gilgilgan's preference for eating iron; tentative seems retained.

rows.en: Iron? Just ordinary iron?
rows.notes: Ayato echoes iron and asks whether it is ordinary iron; deliberate echo fragments retained.

rows.en: Right. We'll use a lump of iron as bait to lead Gilgilgan around... and buy ourselves time.
rows.notes: Haruka explains lump-of-iron bait and movement to buy time; we and ourselves restored.

rows.en: So I just need to carry it around with RahXephon, right?
rows.notes: Ayato offers to carry the iron with RahXephon; I restored, not an order to Haruka.

rows.en: But that would keep both your hands busy, wouldn't it? So we'll use a machine made of iron.
rows.notes: Haruka rejects Ayato's proposal because both hands would be occupied; iron machine alternative retained.

rows.en: But the Nahel Argama team's machines... They're made of special metals like Gundarium alloy and Super Alloy Z, right?
rows.notes: Ayato points out the team's machines use special alloys; both examples and question retained. Central Gundarium alloy entry read after root sourced Akurasu and official Gundam; source grade remains unspecified.

rows.en: Where would we find a machine made of ordinary iron...
rows.notes: Ayato's question about where to find an ordinary-iron machine trails off deliberately.

rows.en: As it happens, we have one.
rows.notes: Haruka counters that such a machine exists; one refers to Borot, not iron bait generally.

rows.en: ...I see. That one.
rows.notes: Hayato recognizes Borot; deliberately abbreviated recognition keeps the referent unnamed.

rows.en: That one, right?
rows.notes: Sayaka echoes recognition of Borot; deictic question retained without inventing group agreement.

rows.en: D-don't tell me... You mean my Borot!?
rows.notes: Boss realizes they mean his Borot; shortened unit name and stutter retained.

rows.en: Of course we do.
rows.notes: Sayaka confirms Boss's guess; subject/verb restored as we do.

rows.en: What!? That thing's made of ordinary iron!?
rows.notes: Ayato is surprised that Borot is ordinary iron; that thing refers to Borot.

rows.en: W-what's with that look!? Are you making fun of it because it's made of iron!?
rows.notes: Boss challenges Ayato's look as contempt for iron construction; question and anger retained.

rows.en: No, I'm honestly impressed... Borot's amazing.
rows.notes: Ayato denies contempt and admires Borot sincerely; explicit I and Borot retained.

rows.en: W-well... You're right about that.
rows.notes: Boss accepts the compliment tentatively; stutter and concession retained.

rows.en: Boss, could I ask you to lure Gilgilgan out for us...?
rows.notes: Misato asks Boss to serve as the lure; Boss is the requested actor.

rows.en: S-so that's where this was going!?
rows.notes: Boss sees the compliment led to dangerous work; startled rhetorical question retained.

rows.en: Captain Katsuragi, sending Borot alone is far too dangerous!
rows.notes: Daisuke warns Captain Katsuragi about Borot going alone; sourced Captain rank retained.

rows.en: Daisuke, I'm not focusing solely on the fact that Borot is made of iron.
rows.notes: Misato tells Daisuke material is only one consideration; explicit I restored.

rows.en: Taking its power, flexibility of movement and ease of escape into account, I judged it the best choice for this mission.
rows.notes: Misato explains power, flexible movement and easy escape as her full rationale; all criteria retained.

rows.en: ...Borot has a lot of features, despite how it looks. It even has a toilet and everything.
rows.notes: Sayaka supports Borot's versatility with the toilet joke; features and appearance concession retained.

rows.en: Um... Creature comforts aren't really relevant here.
rows.notes: Misato answers the toilet tangent; creature comforts renders habitability naturally.

rows.en: Anyway, you'll do it for us, won't you, Boss?
rows.notes: Sayaka asks Boss to agree; request direction and rhetorical question retained.

rows.en: Please, Boss... Help us save the city of Shanghai.
rows.notes: Michiru asks Boss to help save Shanghai; please attaches to Boss's help.

rows.en: I'd love to see Borot looking cool, too.
rows.notes: Maria appeals to Boss's pride by wishing to see Borot look cool; I restored.

rows.en: Oh...
rows.notes: Boss's hesitant vocal response; deliberate interjection fragment retained.

rows.en: You can do it, Boss!
rows.notes: Allenby encourages Boss's ability; you can do it directly restored.

rows.en: I know you can do it, Boss.
rows.notes: Haruka also encourages Boss's ability; you subject retained.

rows.en: Please, Boss. Everything depends on you.
rows.notes: Misato begs Boss, saying everything depends on him; asking direction retained.

rows.en: Y-yeah! Just leave it to yours truly!!
rows.notes: Boss eagerly accepts, asking them to rely on him; leave it to me direction appropriate here.

rows.en: B-Boss, are you sherious!?
rows.notes: Nuke questions Boss's seriousness; stutter and source lisp represented with sherious.

rows.en: Don't let it go to your head and make promises like that so lightly!!
rows.notes: Mucha objects to Boss's rash promise under flattery; both getting carried away and easy promise retained.

rows.en: Hey, hey, you two!
rows.notes: Boss addresses Nuke and Mucha; two listeners resolved from neighboring lines.

rows.en: Everyone's counting on us and Borot, after all!
rows.notes: Boss explains the group relies on his crew and Borot; us includes Nuke and Mucha.

rows.en: If we back down now, we wouldn't be real men!
rows.notes: Boss invokes masculine pride against backing down; manhood claim preserved.

rows.en: Ah... But I have a bit of a bad feeling about this.
rows.notes: Maria nevertheless expresses foreboding; I restored.

rows.en: So do I...
rows.notes: Akira echoes Maria's foreboding; So do I restores the subject while keeping the deliberate trailing form.

rows.en: G-give me a break! When you two say that, it makes my resolve waver!
rows.notes: Boss asks the two intuitive allies to stop undermining his resolve; you two refers to Maria and Akira.

rows.en: You'll be fine, you'll be fine. If things get rough, just run away.
rows.notes: Tapp reassures Boss and advises escape if danger worsens; you and explicit conditional retained.

rows.en: Right. You might as well let it eat an arm or two.
rows.notes: Light suggests sacrificing Borot arms to feed the monster; robot limbs inferred, not human arms.

rows.en: Maybe it'll even get an upset stomach.
rows.notes: Kaine jokes Borot might upset Gilgilgan's stomach; it is the monster.

rows.en: Y-you bastards... You think this has nothing to do with you...!
rows.notes: Boss resents the Dragonar trio treating his danger as someone else's problem; hostile force retained.

rows.en: Then I'll go report the details of the plan to Captain Bright.
rows.notes: Misato goes to report the operation to Bright; I and reporting action restored.

rows.en: ...So you've finally croaked. You weren't much of a workout for my recovery.
rows.notes: Separate event 11: Tetsuya thinks the fallen Gilgilgan is dead and boasts about rehabilitation.

rows.en: Did you really defeat it...?
rows.notes: Jun doubts whether Tetsuya defeated the monster; you and it restored.

rows.en: Yeah. It won't be moving anymore.
rows.notes: Tetsuya assures Jun the monster will not move again; it restored.

rows.en: Tetsuya!
rows.notes: Koji greets Tetsuya; vocative-only fragment retained.

rows.en: It's been a while, Koji.
rows.notes: Tetsuya greets Koji after a long separation; complete English greeting.

rows.en: Are you all right now? Have your injuries healed?
rows.notes: Koji asks after Tetsuya's injuries; explicit subject and healed action.

rows.en: Yeah, as you can see. Though that space lizard wasn't much of a workout to help me recover.
rows.notes: Tetsuya claims recovery and calls Gilgilgan a space lizard; rehabilitation boast retained.

rows.en: Tetsuya, what do you mean by a space lizard?
rows.notes: Koji asks which creature Tetsuya means by space lizard; implied meaning verb restored.

rows.en: The thing lying over there. Those Vegan Empire guys called it Gilgilgan.
rows.notes: Tetsuya identifies the fallen monster and gives the Vegan Empire designation. Guys keeps his casual rough register without adding a noun epithet absent from source.

rows.en: Gilgilgan...?
rows.notes: Duke echoes the monster's name; deliberate name-only question retained.

rows.en: Yeah. But it sure didn't live up to its name. You could take it back and make a specimen out of it.
rows.notes: Tetsuya dismisses the monster despite its name and suggests taking it as a specimen; both clauses retained.

rows.en: No, wait! Gilgilgan is still alive!
What!?
Ta-da! Here comes Boss Borot!
Hey, space monster! Your mom's got an outie!
rows.notes: Childish outie-bellybutton insult retained.

rows.en: Spank, spank! Come and get me, monster! Right over here, by my butt!
rows.notes: Playground tag taunt redirects monster toward Boss's butt; spank chant retained.

rows.en: B-Boss! It's coming!!
Of course it is! That's what we're here for!
Yoo-hoo! The iron over here is nice and sweet!
If you keep saying that, it's really gonna eat ush!
rows.notes: Nuke's comic lisp rendered as ush.
uncertain: The implicit threatened party is interpreted as Boss and his crew together; Nuke speaks from aboard Boss Borot.

rows.en: Shut up! They asked us to do this, and as a man, I can't back out now!!
rows.notes: Boss accepts the women's request from earlier context; restores his own resolve as a man.

rows.en: Boss, can you hear me? This is where you need to lure Gilgilgan.
If you lure Gilgilgan into that ironworks, it should stop moving to eat the iron...
Then we'll concentrate our attacks on it.
Yeah! Leave it to me!
I'm counting on you. Make a face that looks like bait, and lure Gilgilgan over!
rows.notes: Misato requests Boss's help; face-as-bait joke retained for Bright's response.

rows.en: ...What would a face like that look like?
rows.notes: Thought; responds to Misato's face-as-bait joke.

rows.en: All right! Here I go!!
1. Lure Gilgilgan to the target point
rows.notes: Victory objective; nominal UI form.

rows.en: 1. Boss Borot is shot down@2. Gilgilgan is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat conditions, not instructions to destroy Boss Borot or Gilgilgan.

rows.en: All right! I lured it right where we wanted it!
You did a great job, Boss!
Piece of cake! I'll leave the rest to you guys!!
Nice work, Boss!
Heh heh heh! That was easy as pie!
Everyone, listen! Once you deal even the slightest damage to Gilgilgan, you must destroy it within 60 seconds.
Don't attack it until you're completely ready to strike!
Understood!
1. Start the next turn with Gilgilgan damaged@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat conditions: next turn begins after damage to Gilgilgan, or allied mothership down.

rows.en: Gilgilgan has stopped moving!
Good! Everyone, now! Make sure you finish it off!!
What's happening!?
rows.notes: Context follows adjacent battle-event exchange; subject and action restored where required.

rows.en: E-Enemy units approaching from above! It's the Vegan Empire!!
What!? Now, of all times!?
Damn them! They must've rushed here when they found out Gilgilgan was down.
rows.notes: Contempt conveyed by rough delivery without added bastard epithet; meaning and settled subject retained.

rows.en: We can't let them distract us! If we don't finish it off quickly, it'll be a repeat of last time!
Recover Gilgilgan at any cost!
King Vega entrusted that precious creature to us!
Hmph. You're as dim-witted as ever.
What did you say!?
Don't lose sight of our goal. If we defeat them here, King Vega won't be angry even if we lose Gilgilgan.
But with Gilgilgan in that condition...!
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing objection preserved.

rows.en: Let it eat your Motherburn. Then it won't just revive. It'll become even more powerful.
I-Is that... really true?
rows.notes: Hesitation in verification question preserved.

rows.en: If you don't trust me, do as you please. Then get the same results you always do.
Ugh...! I-I have no choice! Send the Motherburn charging in!
W-What!?
Commander Jigra, I'll leave the rest to you!
rows.notes: Blacky entrusts remaining operation to Jigra.

rows.en: Yes.
...In exchange, I'll leave you to take the blame.
rows.notes: Thought; Jigra privately assigns blame to Blacky.

rows.en: What the hell is that bastard doing!?
This is bad! He went and fed the giant saucer's energy to Gilgilgan!
rows.notes: Contempt conveyed by rough delivery without added bastard epithet; meaning and settled subject retained.

rows.en: W-What did you say!?
Heh heh heh... It's too late to realize that now!
G-Gilgilgan is giving off high energy readings! It's undergone another metamorphosis!!
rows.notes: Stutter stays on Gilgilgan; metamorphosis is biological transformation, not perversity.

rows.en: Impossible...!
Th-This is the worst...!!
That bastard's gotten even bigger than before!!
So that means its energy capacity has increased that much...!?
Y-Yes...!
Damn it! Has our whole plan gone to waste...!?
It's still too soon to give up!!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ??? despite context identifying Tetsuya.
Bare surprise exclamation retained.

rows.en: Great's emergency repairs are done. I'm joining the lizard hunt, too.
...Tetsuya, about what happened earlier...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished apology/topic preserved.

rows.en: We'll talk later. Right now, we'll defeat Gilgilgan... with our combined strength.
Tetsuya...!
What? You've already made up?
I told you there was nothing to worry about.
Everyone, we defeat Gilgilgan the same way as before!
Once you damage it even once, destroy it within 60 seconds!
Roger! Let's go, Ryo!
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo kept distinct from Ryoma.

rows.en: Yeah!
We did it! This time, we destroyed it for good!
We barely made the time limit... Everyone, you did a great job.
Good. Destroy the remaining enemy units!
1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: We failed to finish it off!? Now we can't stop Gilgilgan!
Captain, all enemy unit signals have disappeared.
All right. Bring all our units back aboard.
Tetsuya... I'm sorry about earlier.
Don't worry about it. You said that to give me a kick in the pants while I was still recovering, didn't you?
rows.notes: Ryoma's harsh words are construed by Tetsuya as a motivating rebuke during recovery.

rows.en: Yeah... But maybe I was sticking my nose where it didn't belong.
No... I was overconfident. That's a fact. Besides, I'm not fighting alone...
During our fight against the Mycenae Empire, you, Koji and the others taught me
rows.notes: Sentence continues in row 320; no terminal punctuation or invented hesitation.

rows.en: That peace is something many people win by joining forces.
rows.notes: Continuation of the lesson stated in row 319; retained subordinate That-clause across row boundary.

rows.en: Tetsuya... You really are...
rows.notes: Deliberate affectionate trailing fragment.

rows.en: Starting today, Jun and I are part of the Nahel Argama team too. We're counting on you.
rows.notes: Tetsuya asks the existing team for support; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Yeah. We're counting on you too.
rows.notes: Ryoma reciprocates Tetsuya's request.

rows.en: Heh heh... Just how I figured it'd turn out.
Koji, you knew things would turn out this way, didn't you?
Could Koji have precognition too?
No way. I just know both Tetsuya and Ryo, that's all.
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo kept distinct from prefilled speaker Ryoma.

rows.en: I believed they'd join forces for a common goal in the end.
That's friendship between men for you. I'm a little jealous.
You bet. Tetsuya and I are the invincible Mazinger duo.
Any dear friend of yours is a friend of mine too, Koji.
Perfect! Let's form a team with me, Tetsuya, and Daisuke to rival the Getter Team!
We're finally heading to Chongqing. Our mission ends there.
Then we retire and live off our pensions. Not bad.
What's wrong, Kaine? Is something worrying you?
N-no...! Nothing's wrong...
Well, we'll be saying goodbye to Maggie soon too. Since it's our last chance, I'll give that body a polish.
rows.notes: Maggie is the D-3 computer nickname; body refers to the machine, no human gender inferred.

rows.en: Yeah. We only ended up piloting them by chance, but they've been our partners all this time...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing description of their machines as partners.

rows.en: They're our beloved machines, after all.
Yeah... Let's at least make them shine when we say goodbye.
...Well then, I'd better get going, Yurika...
rows.notes: Misumaru addresses absent Yurika; retained pause.

rows.en: ...Are you getting along with Akito? ...Yurika...
rows.notes: Misumaru asks Yurika about Akito; no invented response.

rows.en: You got the image data from the Aoi Report through the investigation committee?
Yes, finally. The real thing.
rows.notes: Authentic report data, as opposed to delay/substitution; clipped final phrase retained.

rows.en: You should've just hacked in and grabbed it ages ago.
We'd get told off for doing that. Still... Maybe there was no point in requesting the data.

rows.notes: Source question-mark reaction retained.

rows.en: You'll see when you look at the images. I'll put them up now.
Oh, this one... It's the black robot that showed up in Kyoto.
This... It's already all over the net, isn't it?
Yeah. It's the one Mokuspo broke the story on.
uncertain: Mokuspo is centrally recorded source romanization; independently established English title unavailable.

rows.en: The mysterious robot that attacked Shirahime, a terminal colony of the Hisago Plan...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing robot description; Shirahime derived from sourced Shirahime Incident.
uncertain: Shirahime is centrally derived from sourced Shirahime Incident and colony note; independent licensed name verification limited.

rows.en: I see. If that's all it is, there was no point in going out of our way to request it.
So the net gets information across faster and more accurately than official military channels.
I'm starting to think the investigation committee is deliberately giving us a hard time...
What, you only just noticed?
That's not what I meant, but...
What do you mean?
The Nadesico's close ties to Nergal Heavy Industries make it unpopular in all sorts of circles.
Sometimes we get the cold shoulder where Commander Misumaru can't see it.
Still, this gives us confirmation.
rows.notes: Official image data corroborates the already leaked black-robot sighting.

rows.en: But a robot just eight meters tall that can perform Boson Jumps...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing setup continued by 363; no robot identity added.

rows.en: Neither Earth nor the Jovian Federation can build one at present, can they?
With something like that, Nergal's probably involved behind the scenes.
Then we should check with them right away...
rows.notes: Hari proposes that they contact Nergal; Ruri says she already did.

rows.en: I already did. They say they haven't built anything like that.
Can we trust that?
Well, that company has plenty of skeletons in its closet.
For example, they sent the old Nadesico to Mars under the Schiaparelli Project, bypassing the military...
rows.notes: Saburota cites Nergal bypassing the military; explicit They subject restored, example trails into 370.

rows.en: They're always doing all sorts of things behind the scenes.

rows.notes: Silence retained in all nine original contexts.

rows.en: Anyway... It's pretty likely the black robot was chasing an anti-Nergal faction, right?
Yes. Something is certain to happen around the Hisago Plan before long.
What should we do?
rows.notes: Saburota asks Ruri what action to take in both uses.

rows.en: The likeliest next target is Amaterasu, one of the Great Spiral's central hubs...
uncertain: Great Spiral is centrally recorded source-literal Hisago-network name; independent licensed English label unavailable.

rows.en: Then shall we head over right away?
Yes. Takiri is the nearest terminal colony to us... We'll head there first.
uncertain: Takiri is centrally recorded source romanization; independent licensed English label unavailable.

rows.en: Harry, please get permission from the Development Corporation through Commander Misumaru.
rows.notes: Ruri instructs Harry to obtain approval via Misumaru; speaker label Hari preserved.
uncertain: Development Corporation is centrally recorded source-short agency; SRW Wiki corroborates Japanese organization, independent licensed English label unavailable.

rows.en: Understood.
I still don't really get it.
What don't you get?
rows.notes: Expanded question to restore verb while retaining broad referent.

rows.en: That Hisago Plan thing. What exactly is it, anyway?
Heh heh heh... Allow me to explain.
The Hisago Plan is a plan to create a Boson Jump network within the solar system.
To do that, they're placing terminal colonies with Chulips built into them throughout the system...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing exposition interrupted by Ginga.

rows.en: Chulips? You mean those flowers that bloom and bloom?
rows.notes: Chulip/flower wordplay retained with reference to blooming; no copyrighted song quote added.

rows.en: No. Um... What were they again?
Chulips are huge structures left behind by an ancient Martian civilization... Basically, they're like gates.
Going through one lets even people who aren't A-Class Jumpers teleport.
An everlasting jumper? Once you put it on, you can't take it off?
rows.notes: Literal permanent-clothing mishearing retained; Japanese A-kyuu/eikyuu pun has no exact English phonetic counterpart.
uncertain: Permanent jumper joke loses the Japanese homophone with A-Class Jumper.

rows.en: No, Ginga. He said A-Class Jumper.
Right. They're people with the ability to perform Boson Jumps on their own.
rows.notes: Amuro defines A-Class Jumpers; explicit They subject restored.

rows.en: Then I bet they can make some really amazing jumps!
You're... imagining skiing or something, aren't you?
To give you an analogy, the Hisago Plan is like a highway with Chulips for its entrances and exits...
rows.notes: Trailing highway analogy continued in 396.

rows.en: Using it makes travel within the solar system possible in a very short time.
When did they build all that?
Right after the Lizard War ended... Before the Gryps Conflict or the Baam War began.
Most terminal colonies were built outside the Earth Sphere... So they didn't suffer much damage.
And when the Baam appeared, it was decided to make the Hisago Plan part of our defense network against aliens.
That's why the Titans, Neo Zeon and Giganos left it alone.
But it didn't do any good against Gulfer or the Vegan Empire!
The Hisago Plan isn't finished yet. For now, the only route runs from Earth to Mars.
Huh... But why would anyone go after it? It's a highway, right?
It's true that the Hisago Plan is essential to humanity's future growth and the defense of the solar system, but...
rows.notes: Deliberately trails into row 406.

rows.en: There are some people who don't approve of it.

rows.notes: Silent reaction preserved.

rows.en: Chulips are huge structures left behind by an ancient civilization on Mars... Basically, they're like gates.
By passing through one, even people who aren't A-Class Jumpers can teleport.
Yes. They're people who can perform a Boson Jump on their own.
You're... picturing ski jumping or something, aren't you?
You could think of the Hisago Plan as a highway with Chulips serving as its entrances and exits...
rows.notes: Highway analogy trails off in source.

rows.en: Using it lets us travel through the solar system in a very short time.
And when the Baam appeared... it was decided to make the Hisago Plan part of our defense network against aliens, so...
rows.notes: Causal setup trails into row 414.

rows.en: The Titans, Neo Zeon and Giganos left it alone.
The Hisago Plan isn't complete yet. Right now, there's only a route from Earth to Mars...
rows.notes: Trailing explanation retained.

rows.en: It's true that the Hisago Plan is essential to humanity's future growth and the defense of the solar system, but...
rows.notes: Deliberately trails into row 417.

rows.en: Some people don't approve of it.
...Terminal colony Takiri is confirmed ahead. The Chulip is deploying.
uncertain: Takiri follows central source romanization; independent licensed name unconfirmed.

rows.en: Set the Distortion Field to maximum output!
rows.notes: Bridge command; speaker orders maximum output.

rows.en: The route is confirmed. Through Takiri, Sayori and Tagitsu to Amaterasu!
rows.notes: Route readout retained.
uncertain: Takiri, Sayori and Tagitsu follow central source romanizations; independent licensed names unconfirmed.

rows.en: Everyone, please run your final checks.
Communication circuits are sealed. Shipboard alert status is pattern B.
rows.notes: Bridge status report; restored copulas instead of retaining grammatical omissions.

rows.en: Field output is normal, too. And everything else is all OK!
Fermion-to-boson conversion is proceeding normally.
All systems aboard the ship are normal.
The level is rising, 6... 7... 8... 9...
rows.notes: Restored subject and verb for level report; numerical count deliberately trails.

rows.en: Jump.
rows.notes: Quiet, matter-of-fact jump command.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: So that's the terminal colony, Amaterasu.
It's nothing like our Shangri-La.
Yeah. It's nothing like the Neo Japan colony either.
rows.notes: Domon agrees with Judau; restored colony comparison subject and verb.

rows.en: With a name like Amaterasu, I get the feeling something must be hidden there.
You mean the Amano-Iwato legend? You really know your stuff.
rows.notes: Central glossary establishes Amano-Iwato; legend reference retained without added myth exposition.

rows.en: Heh... Meeting Domon got me interested in the mysteries of the East.
With a name like Amaterasu, I get the feeling something must be hidden there.
You mean the Amano-Iwato legend? You're quite the scholar, Eris.
rows.notes: Central glossary establishes Amano-Iwato; legend reference retained without added myth exposition.

rows.en: What do you mean?
It's a long story, so I'll skip it. Anyway, the hard part starts now.
...The Nadesico will hold at its current position.
Huh? Aren't we going to park it?
When you're investigating, a little distance gives you the best perspective. Harry, you understand... don't you?
rows.notes: Ruri covertly directs Harry to investigate while she distracts security.

rows.en: Y-yes...
I'll go pay my respects to Amaterasu's chief of security.
But...
rows.notes: Deliberate objection fragment.

rows.en: The captain's buying you time. Don't let her down.
rows.notes: Captain buys time for Harry; imperative directed to Harry.

rows.en: Y... yes...
Vega, Domon... I'm sorry to ask, but would you come with me?
As bodyguards? All right.
Then I'll bring Valkyrie along.
rows.notes: Valkyrie is Vega's motorcycle; Vega brings it herself.

rows.en: Who the hell are you people!?
I'm Major Ruri Hoshino of the Earth Federation Space Force.
rows.notes: Central affiliation entry used; Earth is present in the full source label.
uncertain: Earth Federation Space Force follows central source-literal MX affiliation; independent licensed MX label unconfirmed.

rows.en: I'm Vega, deputy commander of GEAR.
I'm Domon Kasshu.
Well, well... Even the King of Hearts is with them. They're certainly bold.
rows.notes: Thought; pronoun them refers to visiting party.

rows.en: That's not what I'm asking! What are you doing here!?
And you're a grown adult, dressing up in cosplay... This is ridiculous!
rows.notes: Azuma addresses Vega directly; restored listener as subject of cosplay rebuke.

rows.en: C-cosplay...!?
What is this supposed to be!? Are you a Red Comet fan or something!?
A-ahaha... That wasn't what I had in mind.
rows.notes: Vega denies intended Red Comet resemblance.

rows.en: ...There should be no problem with the Space Force entering an Earth Federation colony, should there?
This is the heart of the Hisago Plan! Did you get the Development Corporation's permission!?
uncertain: Development Corporation follows central source-short label; independent licensed English name unconfirmed.

rows.en: We did. That's why we're here.
W-what!?
You're imagining things, that's all. Right, Domon?
rows.notes: Vega tries to smooth over Domon's blunt answer; not a literal perception diagnosis.

rows.en: I only stated the facts.
Such insolence! What on earth do you want here!?
...An abnormal increase in bosons was confirmed during the recent Shirahime incident.
uncertain: Shirahime follows central source-short colony name; independent licensed verification limited.

rows.en: If there's a problem with the management of the jump system... it will affect nearby routes and colonies.
The Colony Management Act's emergency inspection clause applies here, so I ask for your understanding.
uncertain: Colony Management Act is source-literal; official English title unconfirmed.

rows.en: Well, just think of it as having your electric meter checked or something.
rows.notes: Vega asks Azuma to regard inspection as routine.

rows.en: There are no flaws in the Hisago Plan!
Now, now, Brigadier General. Maintaining peace in space is the mission of our Federation Space Force...
rows.notes: Mission explanation trails into row 472. Central affiliation entry used; Earth is absent from the source-short label.
uncertain: Federation Space Force follows central source-literal MX affiliation; independent licensed MX label unconfirmed.

rows.en: Let's put our earnest, duty-bound major's mind at ease.
What did you say!?
The Hisago Plan, the Great Spiral spanning space... Boson Jumping, the transport of the future.
rows.notes: Deliberate promotional noun phrases.
uncertain: Great Spiral follows central source-literal label; independent licensed name unconfirmed.

rows.en: Why don't we take this opportunity to let everyone have a good, long look?
But...!
rows.notes: Interrupted objection.

rows.en: They've come all the way out here, after all...
rows.notes: Causal fragment continues into row 478.

rows.en: It wouldn't do to send them away empty-handed, would it? Show them your generosity, Brigadier General.
rows.notes: Empty-handed means visitors leaving without satisfactory inspection results.

rows.en: Grr...!
rows.notes: Frustrated vocalization.

rows.en: Then we can let everyone return to Earth with their minds at ease.
Hmph... If you insist, very well.
Thank you for your consideration.
But there's a time limit! I won't tolerate some modified human roaming around Amaterasu!
rows.notes: Azuma's discriminatory modified-human insult retained; genetic context not inserted into his wording.

rows.en: Well, thank you.
...Hmm... Area 1101 cleared... Shall we get going, Omoikane?
rows.notes: Numeric area label1101 retained.

rows.en: Data, silk-strained... Send me each batch of soup as it's ready. Speed: intermediate wanko...
rows.notes: Cooking-style processing fragments retain silk-straining, sequential soup delivery and opaque intermediate wanko speed, as root requested.
uncertain: Cooking-style silk-straining and sequential soup/data delivery retain source metaphor; intermediate wanko is an opaque speed parameter whose precise intended value is not established.

rows.en: Hey!
Aaaaaah!!
Huh? Harry?
rows.notes: Body nickname Harry; speaker label Hari remains prefilled.

rows.en: What's got you so startled?
Don't come into my Window Ball without permission!
rows.notes: Window Ball follows new centralized campaign_terms source-English-form entry; no inferred mechanics.
uncertain: Window Ball is transparent source English-form terminology; no exact independent Akurasu or licensed English label established.

rows.en: What's the big deal? It's not like we're strangers.
Huh?
W-What are you saying!? You perverrrrrt!
rows.notes: Saburota's intimacy innuendo elicits elongated pervert accusation.

rows.en: Oh? You've got a wider range of reactions now.
Hee hee! You and Captain Takasugi get along well, Harry.
rows.notes: Body Harry retained, source rank Captain.

rows.en: You bet! We're so close, we even bathe together. Right?
rows.notes: Saburota teases about shared bathing, continuing innuendo.

rows.en: ...Siiigh...
Hm? You're not getting mad?
...Is it really okay... for us to be doing this?
What's with you? Your moods are all over the place.
This is hacking, you know! Even if they won't cooperate...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished reservation preserved.

rows.en: We don't have a choice. The investigation committee seems to be hiding something, too.
But... don't you feel sorry for the captain...?
Why are you getting all sentimental now? It's this mouth, this mouth of yours!
rows.notes: Saburota appears to grab Hari's mouth; repeated mouth taunt preserved.

rows.en: M-Mmph! S-Stop it, please!
Well, that captain is playing the fool along with Vega and the King of Hearts...
rows.notes: Ruri, Vega and Domon/King of Hearts feign cluelessness to buy hacking time.

rows.en: Let's grab whatever we can while they're doing that, okay?
That's right, Harry. We can't stay here very long.
Y-Yeah...
Honestly... What's that man's problem? He had no right to speak to the captain like that!
It's true, so I don't mind.
I see...
At this stage, genetic modification is the only way a flesh-and-blood human can survive a Boson Jump.
rows.notes: Thought; genetic modification necessary for flesh-and-blood Boson Jump survival.

rows.en: This girl carries that burden... and yet she's accepted it so firmly.
rows.notes: Thought; Ruri's acceptance is the referent.

rows.en: ...Have we bought enough time with this?
Yes. Harry should find a lead any moment now.
Ah, just as I thought...! There's a section that isn't on the official plans.
So there is a reason they're being attacked. Come on, let's keep going!
Th-This is... a report on jump experiment results...!?
Have we hit the jackpot?
Boson Jump experiments on human subjects...!
What!?
These are all unofficial...!
Hey, this list is of A-Class Jumpers...!
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished discovery; A-Class Jumper term.

rows.en: Aah!
Have they spotted us!?
Deactivate mode! Block Omoikane's data! Divert the intruding data to the bypass!
rows.notes: Operator commands, not narrative control codes.

rows.en: The windows are full of text...! Has the program gone haywire!?
What the hell is this...!?
"OTIKA"... Otika!? Wh-What does that mean...?
rows.notes: Exact uppercase displayed string OTIKA; spoken reading Otika.

rows.en: It can't be... This is...!
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished realization.

rows.en: What is this!? The windows are full of some word, OTIKA!
Do something, quickly! What if we're attacked while it's like this!?
It's about time. Well then, Brigadier General... farewell.
rows.notes: Thought; Yamasaki privately anticipates next event.

rows.en: This is urgent! Get it under control!! Restore the system, now!!
Th-The windows have gone completely haywire...!
OTIKA... What does it mean!?
...Harry, did you mess up?
It wasn't me! Amaterasu's computers are fighting each other!
Fighting?
Yes, that's right! There's an unofficial system in Amaterasu!
This whole fuss is like it's telling everyone it exists... or maybe it's just laughing its head off...!
rows.notes: Unofficial system announces itself or laughs; alternative interpretations retained.

rows.en: ...OTIKA...
rows.notes: Thought; exact mystery string OTIKA.

rows.en: ...OTIKA... AKITO...?
rows.notes: Thought; exact reversal clue OTIKA / AKITO.
Source punctuation-only exclamation retained.

rows.en: Captain, what should we do!?
We're returning to the Nadesico.

rows.notes: Source punctuation-only surprise retained.

rows.en: The enemy is coming!
Whaaat!?
Is it that same one again?
Yes, most likely. Could it be Nergal?
rows.notes: Hidden speaker stays ???; Nergal speculative identity, no invented gender.

rows.en: Who knows... By the way, isn't it a bit early for you to be wearing that outfit?
rows.notes: Unidentified person's outfit deliberately unspecified.

rows.en: I-I'm sorry.
Well, let's say you're starting by looking the part. So, what about that group?
rows.notes: Yamasaki accepts dressing the part and asks about the previously discussed group.

rows.en: They said they'd be here in five minutes.
rows.notes: Reported promise: group will arrive in five minutes, not depart then.

rows.en: Oh, that's a problem. Then we'll pull out in five minutes.
If we go straight through here, we'll be at the exit in no time!
Can the Valkyrie really handle three riders?
rows.notes: Valkyrie is Vega's motorcycle; Ruri questions carrying all three occupants.

rows.en: It's fine, it's fine! Doesn't this sort of thing get you fired up?
I'm sorry, really.
...My hunch was right. The enemy came...
rows.notes: Thought; hunch refers to anticipated enemy arrival.

rows.en: Was that a code? Was it a coincidence?
rows.notes: Thought retains questions about cryptic earlier communication without explaining it.

rows.en: But that person... Those people...
rows.notes: Thought retains unfinished shift from one person to several; no identities or gender added.

rows.en: Those moves...! What the... Do I know this one...!?
rows.notes: Ryoko recognizes the movement; target remains unidentified.

rows.en: If the Martian Successors start misusing the technology in the ruins, then...
rows.notes: Conditional deliberately trails into 568.

rows.en: Then we'll face a war even worse than the Lizard War...!
You lot! What are you plotting with Giganos!?
rows.notes: Domon angrily challenges the enemies; harsh you lot preserves address without added noun epithet.

rows.en: The Lizard War's over! What are you trying to pull now!?
You guys! Quit darting around! You're getting on my nerves!
Calm down, Ginga! If we let their speed throw us off, we'll lose!
Martian Successors, economic boom, whatever! You attacked us, so don't expect to leave in one piece!
rows.notes: Dismissive pun pairs successors with economic boom in source; literal second notion retained.
uncertain: Japanese successors/economic-boom wordplay loses its phonetic connection in literal English.

rows.en: If these really are remnants of the Jovian Federation, then the ones behind them must be...
rows.notes: Suspicion deliberately trails off; no mastermind named.

rows.en: This looks like it's going to be more trouble than I thought...!
Are these guys remnants of the Jovian Federation!?
I don't know! But if they are, leaving them alone could lead to something disastrous!
Bose particle levels are rising! It's a Boson Out!
rows.notes: Bose particles and Boson Out follow sourced glossary; no extra physical mechanism.
uncertain: Boson Out is source-form terminology; independent licensed English designation unavailable.

rows.en: It's about ten meters long and five meters wide... We can't identify it, and there's no response!
rows.notes: Sensor report gives length and width, distinct from earlier eight-meter height.

rows.en: You've shown yourself, you damned Black Ghost!
Th-that thing... Is it going to attack us!?
No way...! It helped us last time!
We still don't know if that thing is on our side.
rows.notes: Unknown allegiance; neutral thing avoids premature pilot identity.

rows.en: Maybe we just happened to have the same enemy last time.
Do you think that thing is our enemy, #男愛称...!?
rows.notes: Male lead nickname placeholder preserved verbatim.

rows.en: I don't know... Not yet.
All right! We'll let them cut our flesh so we can break their bones!!
rows.notes: Flesh/bone idiom retained; colony collateral-risk reply establishes willingness to take damage for victory.

rows.en: I authorize attacks inside the colony and in the surrounding area!
What!? But then the colony will...!
rows.notes: Shinjo trails off about danger to colony.

rows.en: Even a flying fly is easy to hit when it stops! Some sacrifices are unavoidable!!
rows.notes: Fly-at-rest maxim retained; sacrifices explicitly kept.

rows.en: All riiight!
I don't know who the hell you are! But if there's just one of you, I can handle you myself!!
That squad leader never changes. Well, I'm glad she's doing fine.
rows.notes: Squad leader is Ryoko, sourced female despite masculine speech style.

rows.en: ...Sorry to keep you waiting.
Captain!
Switch to combat mode and stay on standby. For now, we'll sit back and watch.
Captain, are you sure we don't need to help?
It seems they don't want our help.
rows.notes: Ruri refers to Azuma declining help; fits both Amuro/Hari prompts.

rows.en: That's right! You lot shut up and watch from there!!
...He's pretty fired up, isn't he?
rows.notes: Hari comments on Azuma's enthusiasm, not Spirit Command.

rows.en: Hah! That guy's got one hell of a big mouth. Is he really going to be all right?
I doubt that's the only enemy unit. We'd better get ready to deploy too.
Yes, please do.
rows.notes: Ruri asks Amuro/Vega to prepare launch in both route alternatives.

rows.en: Aren't we going to help?
I doubt that's the only enemy unit. We'd better get ready to deploy too.
...Harry, hack into Amaterasu again while we have the chance.
rows.notes: Ruri gives Harry a direct hacking instruction; speaker Hari unchanged.

rows.en: What? Again!?
Yes. The keyword is... 'AKITO'.
rows.notes: AKITO uppercase keyword preserved; runtime/code-sensitive content.

rows.en: Huh? Akito!?
Could that mean...!?
rows.notes: Thought realization deliberately trails; no named identity added.

rows.en: What's going on, Captain!? Captain!
Raise IFS feedback to level ten. Set shipboard alert pattern A...
rows.notes: Operational instructions preserve IFS, level 10 and pattern A.

rows.en: I'm taking control of the system.
rows.notes: Ruri explicitly declares taking system control; subject and action restored.
uncertain: System-control declaration interpreted as Ruri taking control from adjacent operational commands.

rows.en: ...Akito...
rows.notes: Deliberate name-only pause.

rows.en: Anyway, one unit probably means it's a diversion... But I'll play along on purpose!
Here I come, ghost robot!!
What!?
It purged its outer armor!?
rows.notes: Armor purge subject is robot, without revealing pilot.

rows.en: It purged its outer armor!?
rows.notes: Same armor-purge observation with Rain speaker preserved.

rows.en: What are you, Gekiganger!?
rows.notes: Gekiganger short source name derived from sourced Gekiganger 3, no extra 3.

rows.en: Heh...
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ???; brief chuckle retained.

rows.en: It vanished!? Are you going inside!?
rows.notes: Ryoko addresses vanished robot; interior means colony, not added destination.

rows.en: Boson Out detected around Amaterasu! They're identified as Batta!
rows.notes: Batta name derived from sourced New Model Batta entry, without adding New Model.
uncertain: Batta short name derived from sourced New Model Batta; no model added to source.
Boson Out source-form designation lacks independently licensed English verification.

rows.en: Batta!?
It's a weapon the Jovian Federation used in the Lizard War!
Then is the Jovian Federation our enemy!?
Well, it's probably camouflage.
They're telling us not to interfere with their treasure hunt.
rows.notes: Treasure-hunt metaphor preserved; enemy intent inferred from camouflage and hacking exchange.
uncertain: Their treasure hunt interpreted as adversaries' covert objective; referent left metaphorical.

rows.en: Captain! Someone besides me is hacking into Amaterasu!
Just as I thought.
rows.notes: Restored I in expectation response.

rows.en: Please wait a little longer.
D-damn you! So those lizards were behind all these incidents!
rows.notes: Azuma angrily curses the lizards; damn you retains hostility without adding noun epithet.

rows.en: You haven't quite hit the mark, but you're close.
rows.notes: Shinjo taunts Azuma: suspicion close, not exact.

rows.en: What!?
Hm!? Gate 13's been opened!? What's that!? I don't know anything about it!!
It does exist, Brigadier General.
rows.notes: Shinjo confirms hidden gate exists; rank follows glossary.

rows.en: What do you mean!?
I mean the farce is over.
rows.notes: Shinjo reveals operation as a farce; no premature faction name.

rows.en: What!? A farce!?
A black machine... A person's obsession...
rows.notes: Deliberate ominous noun phrases; obsession refers to unidentified black-machine pilot.

rows.en: What are you plotting!? Who are you people!?
Enemies of Earth, enemies of the Jovian Federation, enemies of all the corruption in the universe...
rows.notes: Deliberate enemy-of enumeration, answered by group identity in 644.

rows.en: We are the "Martian Successors"!!
rows.notes: Organization self-identification; retained quotation marks.

rows.en: The Martian Successors!?
...I see. So that's what you're called.
So you're not the Jovian Federation!?
No... If they know so much about the ruins on Mars, they're former Jovian Federation members...!
rows.notes: Vega infers prior Jovian Federation membership from ruins knowledge.

rows.en: If so, this is the Lizard War all over again... Things are heading in the worst possible direction, beyond anything we imagined!
...All units, please launch.
Are you sure that's all right!?
Yes. Let's find out what the enemy is after... what they're really after.
The Nadesico will hold its position. Everyone, head for that gate...
rows.notes: Instruction continues through 654-655; retains source boundary.

rows.en: Enter Amaterasu...
rows.notes: Instruction fragment continues into 655.

rows.en: And proceed to the front of the third barrier beyond Gate 13.
rows.notes: Continues Ruri's multi-row instruction; destination explicitly restored.

rows.en: Roger!
Tch! Of all things, it's a crime by our own people!
rows.notes: Our own people means former comrades/insiders, not family.

rows.en: Well, I've come this far, so I'm going all the way! I'll head there too!!
rows.notes: Poison-and-plate idiom rendered as going all the way, without a literal food reference.

rows.en: 1. Allied units reach the destination
rows.notes: Victory objective; source has zero @ separators. Neutral source-collective objective; no added any-one/all-units trigger claim.

rows.en: 1. Ryoko is shot down@2. Saburota is shot down@3. Allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Three loss objectives; preserves exactly two @ separators.

rows.en: W-what!?
That's the one that appeared in Kyoto and at La Vie en Rose...!
rows.notes: Route-dependent prior encounter includes Kyoto and La Vie en Rose.

rows.en: That's the one that appeared in Kyoto...!
rows.notes: Alternate prior encounter mentions Kyoto alone.

rows.en: Then they're with the Martian Successors too!
That bastard's making fools of us! What the hell do they want so badly!?
rows.notes: Ryoko's angry question targets black-machine pilot. Gender-neutral pilot reference; no identity revealed.

rows.en: ...There's no time. Everyone, please hurry to the destination.
I'm sorry I didn't greet you sooner. It's been a while, Ryoko.
Yeah, two years. You look well.
You're as impressive as ever.
And yet look at the mess I'm in. Anyway... thanks for the support.
Not at all. We'll guide you from here on.
Hey, you! You're hacking someone else's system, aren't you!?
The enemy is doing it too, and it's an emergency. Oh, and Harry is the one doing it, by the way...
rows.notes: Ruri playfully shifts hacking responsibility to Harry; trailing speech retained.

rows.en: C-Captain, that's mean!
Anyway, Ryoko... I have a favor to ask.
rows.notes: Ruri asks Ryoko for a favor; request direction restored.

rows.en: A favor?
Th-that's the one!
Was that machine trying to get here too!?
Is it going to attack us...!?
No, it isn't...!
Hey! Get back here!!
How far is that pilot planning to go!?

rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ???; every repeated exclamation checked.

rows.en: ...Sorry, but I took the liberty of attaching a wire for wired communications.
rows.notes: Ryoko has attached a wired communication cable; not requesting permission now.

rows.en: I was just asked to do it. This girl says she wants to talk to you.
rows.notes: Ryoko relays Ruri's request to the silent pilot.

rows.en: ...Hello. I'm Major Ruri Hoshino of the Federation Space Force.
rows.notes: Retains source military rank Major, not original-series profile rank.
uncertain: Federation Space Force follows central source-short MX affiliation; independent licensed MX label unconfirmed.

rows.en: I'm sorry we forced this on you.
Since you've blocked both incoming and outgoing window communications, I asked Ryoko to relay for me.
rows.notes: Ruri requested Ryoko to act as relay because pilot blocks communication in both directions.
uncertain: Window communications follows central source English-form entry; independent licensed label unconfirmed.

rows.en: Um... Please tell me...
rows.notes: Deliberately suspended request before identity question.

rows.en: Who... are you? Are you...
rows.notes: Identity question deliberately trails into another question; no hidden-name disclosure.

rows.en: ...Lapis, decode the password.
rows.notes: Hidden speaker commands Lapis; labels remain hidden.

rows.en: There's no time. You can watch if you want.
rows.notes: Hidden pilot permits watching despite lack of time; not requesting to watch.

rows.en: What!?
Th-that's...! I-identification... NERGAL ND-001... N-Nadesico A...!
rows.notes: Identification code NERGAL ND-001 preserved exactly; discovery stutters retained.

rows.en: Nadesico A...!? The one from the Lizard War...!
rows.notes: Deliberate identification fragment.

rows.en: Th-that's... the old Nadesico!?
N-no... How could this...!!
rows.notes: Interrupted disbelief retained.

rows.en: Ruri!! Are you seeing this!?
Ryoko...
rows.notes: Vocative-only response repeats during discovery and grief; both uses checked.

rows.en: What the hell is this...!
Ryoko, calm down...
What is that!?
Ryoko...!
What the hell is that thing!?
Ryoko!
Grrr...!!
...Its shape has changed, but those are the ruins. The ruins on Mars that both Earth and Jupiter were after in the Lizard War three years ago...
