rows.notes: Source names Earth/Jupiter, not expanding to political factions; trailing explanation retained. Were after preserves seeking/targeting without asserting a fight at the ruins.

rows.en: The black box behind Boson Jumping...
rows.notes: Deliberate black-box apposition follows ruins identification.

rows.en: So this was what the Hisago Plan really was?
That's right.
...Ruri...
Huh?
With this... they'll never rest in peace...
rows.notes: The victims/comrades Ryoko mourns are not named in this line; neutral they retained.
uncertain: The mourned companions are unspecified in this line; neutral they avoids inventing names.

rows.en: Why is this thing here...!?
For the future of humanity!!
What!?
Lieutenant General... Kusakabe!?
Ryoko, on your right!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker warns Ryoko of threat on her right; does not identify speaker.
Punctuation reaction occurs twice; both uses read.

rows.en: Aaaaah!!
Th-There are still more of them!?
On Lieutenant General Kusakabe's orders, we, the Martian Successors, are seizing the Hisago Plan!
rows.notes: Kusakabe's glossary rank Lieutenant General retained; Shinjo broadcasts occupation.

rows.en: My apologies so soon after our takeover. We are now abandoning Amaterasu... and blowing it up.
rows.notes: Occupation announcement immediately followed by abandonment and demolition, intentionally contradictory courtesy.

rows.en: Friend or foe, evacuate this sector. I repeat...
rows.notes: Broadcast to friend and foe; repeated announcement trails off.

rows.en: They're awfully conscientious...
Did you get the data?
Ah, yes!
Then everyone... withdraw immediately, please.
Withdraw!?
This doesn't concern you. Get out of here, now.
rows.notes: Hidden rescuer's label remains ???.

rows.en: Y-You're...!?
rows.notes: Unfinished recognition remains unfinished.

rows.en: Hurry. He's coming...!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker warns that Hokushin is approaching; male profile establishes pronoun.

rows.en: In a single night it stretches to the heavenly realm... a gourd-shaped spiral through space...
rows.notes: Archaic poetic gourd-shaped cosmic spiral imagery; heavenly realm is descriptive, not invented proper place.
uncertain: Archaic poetic line rendered with heavenly realm and gourd-shaped space spiral; syntax and imagery retained without a named mythological location.

rows.en: Will you die in front of a woman?
rows.notes: Explicit spatial in front of preserves woman reference for Ryoko's reply; no possessive invented.

rows.en: Woman!?
G-Ghhhh...!!
rows.notes: Pain grunt preserved.

rows.en: You fool, still clinging to a woman who will never return... Watch closely.
rows.notes: Hokushin says woman will not return, without adding death claim.

rows.en: Akito! It's you, isn't it!? So that's why you called me Ryoko... Hey!
rows.notes: Ryoko recognizes Akito through his affectionate Ryoko-chan address; unresolved nickname texture.
uncertain: Ryoko-chan recognition is rendered as called me Ryoko, dropping honorific per project convention; emotional affectionate-address cue is less explicit.

rows.en: Perish...!
rows.notes: Hokushin's terse lethal exclamation.

rows.en: You idiots! Turn back!! Yurika and Akito are...!!
rows.notes: Unfinished anguished Yurika/Akito warning preserved.

rows.en: ...It's the captain's orders. Sorry.
rows.notes: Saburota follows Ruri's withdrawal order, not enemy command.

rows.en: Ruri! Answer me! You can hear me, can't you!? You can see them, can't you!?
They were alive! They were alive, Ruri!!
Are we letting them die again...!? Damn it... Damn it!!
rows.notes: Ryoko accuses the team of abandoning living friends to die again.

rows.en: Deactivate combat mode. Once all units are aboard, we'll leave this sector...
rows.notes: Ruri recalls units then leaves threatened sector.

rows.en: Roger...!
Ruri! Why did you order us to pull out!?
They...! We thought they were dead, but they were alive!!
Didn't you feel anything when you saw those two!? Huh!?
Say something, Ruri...! Damn it, please say something...!
...First, we have to accept the facts.
rows.notes: Stray closing Japanese wrapper ignored as instructed.
Stray wrapper ignored; original exclamation remains.

rows.en: Then let's think about what we should do.
Th-That's such a stock answer...!
Harry, send our report to Commander Misumaru immediately, please.
Y-Yes.
Rain, do you have any idea what condition Yurika is in?
I think... she's been organically linked to the ruins somehow...
rows.notes: Rain's hypothesis: organic link to the ruins, not confirmed mechanics.

rows.en: And she's in a state of suspended animation...
rows.notes: Suspended animation, not asserted death.

rows.en: What are the chances of restoring her to normal?
I think they're very high. ...I've been through something similar myself...
rows.notes: Rain cites her own parallel experience.

rows.en: I see.
Um, Captain... What are we going to do now...?
We'll return to Earth for now and rejoin the Nahel Argama team.
H-Hey! Aren't we going after them... the ones who took Yurika!?
rows.notes: Both postbattle occurrences checked; pursuers would be enemies who took Yurika.

rows.en: If we had no other enemies, I would.
rows.notes: Counterfactual condition: other ongoing enemies prevent immediate chase.

rows.en: Besides, it would be unwise to pursue them without detailed information about the Martian Successors.
rows.notes: Both branches keep tactical information rationale.

rows.en: Ruri... You...
rows.notes: Unfinished emotional address retained, both occurrences.

rows.en: ...I'm surprised she isn't more down.
Don't be stupid. The captain's hurting more than anyone.
rows.notes: Captain Ruri is the person hurting most; stray wrapper ignored.

rows.en: She still keeps a photo of those two by her captain's seat, you know?
rows.notes: Photo of Yurika/Akito still displayed at captain's seat.

rows.en: I-I see...
And she knows that if she lets herself get upset, it'll affect everyone else...
rows.notes: Vega explains Ruri's emotional restraint affects crew; both occurrences.

rows.en: That's why she's fighting so hard to hold it together now.
